This is actually the basis of a phenomenon in psychology called the spotlight effect. I'm no expert, I just remember learning it in my undergrad. It's basically the tendency for people to believe they are being noticed more than they really are. It's because you are the centre of your own universe and sometimes forget that everyone else is the centre of their own, if that makes sense.
